capabilities: Chat with AI about the current note or attached notes, text files, and images
Let the AI edit notes while approving or rejecting permission requests
Switch between configured models, reasoning levels, and plan/build modes
Resume previous conversations from a session history list
Export conversations to Markdown notes in a chosen folder
extras: The plugin provides only the chat interface; opencode handles model calls, tool execution, and sessions, and must be installed with a model provider configured via 'opencode auth login'. If opencode is not found, its executable path must be set in plugin settings.
intentEvidence: Originally forked from obsidian-yolo. OpenYOLO is now developed independently
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI chat, and users want an agent that can read their notes, make edits, and ask permission before changing files.

relations.evidence: It connects to a local opencode backend through the Agent Client Protocol (ACP).

summary: Sidebar AI chat client that connects to a local opencode backend to ask about, edit, and organize notes.
